hook: Your camera here catches light cutting through solid rock.
title: Light Beams Cut Through This Canyon
description:
Antelope Canyon in Arizona is a slot canyon of smooth, wave-like orange sandstone. Flash floods carved it over time, and sunlight drops in as bright beams. It looks like a different planet, but it's in the US Southwest.

#Shorts #AntelopeCanyon #PlacesThatShouldntExist
